content:
pwc_auditor: Hi Redwood team — quick ask for the SOC2/ISO evidence packet. Need mapping for control A.6 (access control changes) and the corresponding RBAC change logs + KMS rotation proof for the last 12 months. Also need a crosswalk showing where each control maps to artifact names. Can you confirm timeframe and expected filenames?

maria: on it. timeframe = last 12 months. we have RBAC changes in k8s & IAM. will sketch mapping and add links to log snapshots.

sanjay: quick Q — do auditors want raw audit logs (S3 object snapshots) or a filtered export with control tags?

pwc_auditor: filtered export is ideal (reduce noise) but retain raw originals. export should include a manifest that ties each exported file to the original S3 path and a checksum.

kelly: noted. plan: 1) filtered CSVs per control 2) tarball of raw logs 3) manifest.json with checksums + mapping. we usually prefix filenames like `redwood-evidence/{control}/{YYYYMM}.tar.gz`. ok? :thumbsup: 

maria: sample manifest entry we'll produce:
```
control: A.6
artifact: s3://redwood-audit/log-exports/A.6/2024-07-snapshot.tar.gz
sha256: 3a7f...
source_range: 2024-07-01T00:00:00Z/2024-07-31T23:59:59Z
notes: includes kube-apiserver audit and iam rolebindings diff
```

own: for RBAC diffs, we'll include the `kubectl diff` outputs and the terraform plan snapshots. I'll export the RoleBinding change set and attach a short timeline: who, when, PR link.

sanjay: KMS rotation proof — do you want CMK rotation logs or KMS key policy history? We have CloudKMS audit entries in cloudtrail + our internal rotation playbook that recorded the HSM calls.

pwc_auditor: Both. Need proof rotation occurred and controls that enforced it. CloudTrail entries + KMS key metadata + rotation schedule/policy.

kelly: assembling a package: `kms-rotation/` with `rotation-schedule.pdf`, `rotation-cloudtrail.csv`, `kms-key-metadata.json`, and `rotation-playbook.md`. I'll redact any secrets.

maria: for audit sampling — auditor asked for 3 random samples per quarter. We'll script sampling from S3 and include verifier script:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/log-exports/A.6/2024-07-snapshot.tar.gz ./
sha256sum 2024-07-snapshot.tar.gz
```

own: incident linkage — auditor requested cross-reference of any RBAC changes tied to incidents in the last 12 months. I have a CSV mapping `incident_id -> rbac_change_artifact` and a short narrative for each. Adding that to `incidents/rbac-links.csv`.

sanjay: retention note: our infra retained kube audit logs for 540 days in S3-Glacier-Deep, but we exported snapshots to hot S3 for packaging. documenting retention & retention policy in `retention-policy.md`.

maria: timeline for deliverables: initial manifest + filtered exports by EOD Friday, full raw tarballs by next Wed, final package + signed manifest by next Fri. anyone blocked?

pwc_auditor: that timeline works. please include a contact for on-the-fly clarifications (Slack + email).

kelly: contact = maria@redwood.ai and @maria here. I'll attach the ticket when exports start.

audit-bot: New evidence export job created #EVID-8421, ETA: 2024-07-19 18:00 UTC. Logs will be staged to `s3://redwood-audit/staging/EVID-8421/`

sanjay: FYI — IAM console snapshots captured via `aws iam get-role --role-name` for any changed roles; saved under `iam/role-snapshots/` with PR link in metadata.

own: adding short write-ups for each control explaining how the artifact satisfies the control statement (2-3 sentence blurbs). helps auditors reduce back-and-forth.

maria: perfect. I'll draft the control crosswalk doc and post a link here once ready.

pwc_auditor: thanks team — looking forward to the package. we'll review and post any follow-ups in this thread.

kelly: moving to action. tagging ops for export creds: @sanjay please kick off the export job when ready. :rocket:
